start.choice: Thank you for your protection, friend.

node.text: heheheh. mine rock. rock mine.~ bite wall? grehehe.

Mind the cairns, wayfarer, lest you knock one over.~ Seen a few baboons today. Not one made it further than a stone's throw.~ The nonsense birds? Don't talk to them, they won't talk to you.~ Can hear you coming from a mile away, wayfarer. I'll be hearing you go, too.

Stones talk sometimes. Just gotta listen real close, and you can hear 'em singing.~ Need something sculpted? Man, boar, fish?~ I sometimes wonder if the stones feel like we do. Carving must hurt then, eh?~ Don't know the name of the rocks around here, but they carve just the same.

Smashed through a wall last week, soaked my clothes. Damn aquifers.~ Overseer said we needed to square away more rock, but my back's been killing me... got any witchwood?~ Ground's not so steady here, wayfarer. I'd watch my step, if're you.~ Ever scraped the moss off these here walls?
=subject.T= =verb:throw= =subject.its= head back and =verb:spit= on the floor in disgust.
Never again, I tell ya... Never again...
Ain't easy work overseein' a warren like this, wayfarer.~ Make sure not to find yourself on the wrong side of the outrider, and you'll do fine.

choice.text: I've come to have something tempered.

node.text: {{emote|*=subject.T= =verb:continue= listening to the rock face without looking at you.*}} I haven't got all cycle to finish this, you know. The sooner those tinker-bears filter out the signal, the better.
{{emote|*=subject.T= =verb:keep= =subject.its= ear pressed to the rock.*}} Can't you see I'm busy here? Go bother the overseer if you need work, wayfarer.

node.choice: Yes, I will take the disk to Grit Gate as you ask.
No, I must make preparations first.

node.text: Come, wayfarer. My stonesup tools are yours to work.~ Helmets, lights, picks... make certain of the stock you buy now, for a missing piece could prove fatal.~ The rocks here are loose. With my wares, you could be rid of them altogether.~ Ah, to feel the sunlight on your skin, wayfarer. Tell me, is it sweeter than the taste of fresh water?
node.choice: You're a plant, right? What kind?

node.text: One of many. A spiral in multitude, radiating through the earth.
node.choice: How did you wind up here?

node.text: The vase called me. It sang of home, of basking in the sun's fading glow, of hearing the howling caves on the horizon. To return, we provide for them.
node.choice: Home? Aren't you just a potted plant?

node.text: And what of home, wayfarer? Do you know of such a thing?
